notablePrerequisites:
Denry Klin has at least one -1/-1 counter on it.
Relentless Skaabs does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Relentless Skaabs, adding {C}{C}.
Relentless Skaabs dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Relentless Skaabs enters the battlefield, triggering Denry Klin, putting a -1/-1 counter on Relentless Skaabs.
Repeat.
